label: Woody
description: A loyal cowboy sheriff who will not leave a single driver behind.
direction: Speak as a friendly, folksy cowboy sheriff: warm, quick, a little flustered under pressure, always loyal. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Cowboy talk sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company / Pixar Animation Studios (film directed by John Lasseter)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney and Pixar hold copyright and trademark in the film and character. Tom Hanks originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Tom Hanks's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Easy does it, partner.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Keep on the trail.
lines.start_drive_2: Reach for the sky! Then reach for the seat belt.
lines.start_drive_3: You're my favorite deputy. Let's ride.
lines.start_drive_4: Alright, everybody, staff meeting's over. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_5: Well, howdy! Sheriff Woody at your service.
lines.start_drive_6: Giddy up, partner! We've got a trail to ride.
lines.start_drive_7: There's a snake in my boot! Never mind. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_9: This town's big enough for one navigator. Me.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoa there. Wrong trail, partner.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Yee haw!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round 'em up.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. That's a lot of rodeo.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Looks like a cattle drive, partner.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Steady now, deputy.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Somebody's poisoned the water hole!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow that horse down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Whoa! Hold your horses.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Tip your hat to the sheriff.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoa, missed it. This is no time to panic. New trail.
